description: AUTHORITATIVE detail for a single Polymarket market by slug or numeric id. Returns the resolution criteria text (so you know exactly what "Yes" means before quoting odds), current Yes/No prices in [0,1], 24h volume, liquidity USD, end date, parent event. Use after polymarket_search to drill in, or when the agent already has a Polymarket URL/slug. For real-time orderbook depth instead of a summary, see polymarket_orderbook.

slug_or_id.description: Market slug (e.g. "will-bitcoin-hit-150k-by-december-31-2027") or numeric id. A dated slug still resolves after it settles — this tool automatically retries a closed-market lookup when the bare lookup misses, so a resolved market's question, prices, and resolution text keep answering. If a plausible slug still 404s after that, re-find it with polymarket_search rather than assuming the market never existed.

name: polymarket_market
